privacy.title: Privacy aur mera data
privacy.sub: Sahaay aapke baare mein kya rakhta hai, kya kabhi nahi rakhta, aur sab kuch kaise delete karein.
privacy.keep1: Jo details aapne save karne ke liye chuni, jaise age ya category, aapki sahmati ke baad.
privacy.keep2: Aapka case: service, jo steps aapne mark kiye, submit karne ki date, aur reference number jo aakhri 4 characters tak chhota kiya gaya.
privacy.keep3: Jin documents ko aapne confirm kiya: sirf checked fields, ID numbers aakhri 4 digits tak.
privacy.never1: Aapke upload kiye photos ya PDFs. Woh memory mein padhe jaate hain aur hata diye jaate hain.
privacy.never2: Poora Aadhaar, PAN, phone ya bank number.
privacy.never3: Hamare banaye PDFs. Woh aapko milte hain, save nahi hote.
privacy.modelNote: AI model sirf wahi text dekhta hai jisme ID numbers pehle se chhupe hon. Free model services mili information use kar sakti hain, isliye chat mein asli ID number kabhi mat likhiye.
privacy.deleteHelp: Isse aapki saved details, cases, documents, steps aur submission details hat jayengi. Ise wapas nahi kiya ja sakta.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Main samajhta/samajhti hoon ki ise wapas nahi kiya ja sakta
privacy.deleted: Aapka saara saved data delete ho gaya.
privacy.error: Load nahi ho paya. Dobara try kijiye.
privacy.deleteError: Delete nahi ho paya. Dobara try kijiye.
privacy.reports: Har jawab ke saath official sources aur check ki date dikhti hai. Kuch galat lage to service card par “Galat information report karein” use kijiye.
privacy.webNote: Agar aapke sawaal ka Sahaay ke paas verified record nahi hai, to woh web par search kar sakta hai. Sirf aapka sawaal, jismein identity numbers pehle hi chhupa diye jaate hain, AI model aur uske search provider (Tavily, ek web search service) ko jaata hai. Web ke jawaab unverified ke roop mein mark hote hain.
